parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The time format is yyyyMMdd or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. The format must be consistent with StartTime.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of data entries. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: RobotInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the chatbot instance.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The time format is yyyyMMdd or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
